mails.subject: Leje af mødelokale for en dag
mails.body:
Hej,

Jeg hedder Birgitte og driver et lille analysebureau, Holmegaard Analyse, med tre ansatte. Vi sidder normalt hjemmefra, og jeg fandt jer via en kollega, som har holdt et møde hos jer i foråret.

Vi skal have et heldagsseminar for vores kunder en gang i løbet af vinteren, men jeg har endnu ikke en dato. Det handler mest om at finde ud af, om det overhovedet er muligt at leje et af jeres lokaler til en hel dag, og hvad det cirka koster. Vi bliver ca. 12 personer.

Det vil være rigtig rart, hvis der er et projektor eller en stor skærm, og hvis vi kan få kaffe og frokost ind udefra. Jeres hjemmeside viser kun en prisliste for timer, så jeg ved ikke, om der er en dagspris.

Jeg ved godt, at det lyder lidt som et løst tilbud, men jeg vil gerne have et overslag, før jeg går videre med planlægningen og vælger dato. Jeg kan tilføje, at vi gerne betaler på faktura med EAN eller almindeligt CVR-nummer.

En ting mere: to af mine ansatte overvejer at leje et fast skrivebord hos jer, så de kommer ud af hjemmekontoret. Kan de komme forbi en dag og prøve det af, og er der overhovedet ledige pladser i åbent kontorlandskab? Hvad koster det om måneden?

Du kan se, hvad vi laver, på www.holmegaard-analyse.example. Der står også et telefonnummer, hvis det er nemmere at ringe.

På forhånd tak for hjælpen.

Venlig hilsen
Birgitte Holmegaard
Holmegaard Analyse ApS
mails.justification: A visitor with a real, specific question about renting a room for a day and a trial for two desks; the website link and company pitch look promotional but she is the one asking and expects a reply, with no date so urgency is 2.

mails.subject: Fwd: Partnership idea from Northbound Fund
mails.body:
Mira here: this looks legit to me, can you take a look before Friday's team meeting?

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Jonas Aabye <jonas.aabye@northbound-fund.example>
Subject: Press feature and co-branded evening series

Dear team,

I am the community lead at Northbound Fund, a small regional foundation supporting early-stage founders. We have followed your space since your open day in June and would like to propose two things.

First, our quarterly magazine would like to run a two-page feature on your space and its resident founders. There is no fee and no advertorial; we only ask for a visit and a few quotes.

Second, we would like to explore a co-branded evening series (four sessions, January to April), with our logo next to yours on invitations. We would cover room hire at your standard rate and a modest contribution of EUR 1,500 towards your costs.

Our programme page has the details: northbound-fund.example/partners. Could we schedule a call in the next two weeks?

Warm regards,
Jonas Aabye
mails.justification: A foundation proposes a press piece and co-branded series after following the space; the offered money and link resemble a sales pitch, but it is a genuine collaboration proposal forwarded by a colleague that needs a reply within the week.

mails.subject: Réseau Wi-Fi commun du bâtiment
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

En notre qualité de représentants des locataires du bâtiment de Havnebakken, nous vous informons que le réseau Wi-Fi de votre espace perturbe depuis trois semaines la connexion du rez-de-chaussée, où nos membres partagent le même canal.

Nous vous prions de bien vouloir ajuster votre point d'accès dans un délai de huit jours, faute de quoi nous saisirons le gestionnaire de l'immeuble.

Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Le secrétariat
mails.justification: Neighbouring tenants' association with a formal, threatening tone writes about a real wifi interference problem and asks for a fix, so it is a complaint needing a reply within days, not spam.

mails.subject: Locked out, card does nothing
mails.body:
Hi,

I'm a member (desk 14, the Fieldnotes Studio team) and I'm standing outside the main entrance right now. My access card has stopped working: the reader blinks red three times and the door stays shut. I tried it ten times, and my colleague's card works fine, so it's not the reader.

I have a laptop with a client deadline for Monday morning inside, and nowhere else to get it. It is also raining.

Another thing I noticed, which might be a security issue: the side door by the bike room does not latch properly. I pushed it and it opened without a card. Someone should check it tonight, because anyone could walk in.

You may think this is a phishing attempt, since I'm writing from my personal account, but I'm really a member. You can check my name against the list. Please call me on +45 5550 0142 or let me in if someone is on call.

Tobias
mails.justification: A member locked out on a Saturday night who reports a door that does not latch is a real, immediate problem needing a human the same day; the unfamiliar personal address is explained by the sender and is not unsolicited.

mails.subject: The October Desk: new rooms, a sale, and a chair auction
mails.body:
Hello neighbour,

Welcome to the October edition of The Desk, the monthly letter from the Lykkegade community. You are receiving it because you signed up at the front desk or on our site.

THIS MONTH AT A GLANCE

1. Two new meeting rooms are open
The old storage room on the second floor is now Room Pelikan (4 seats) and Room Tangle (8 seats). Both have screens and whiteboards. Book them through the usual booking tool.

2. Autumn offer: 20% off day passes
Bring a friend and your next three day passes cost 20% less. The code is HYGGE20 and works until 31 October. This is a limited offer, so grab it while it lasts.

3. Chair auction on Friday 16 October
We are replacing 30 old chairs. Bids start at DKK 50, proceeds go to the community kitchen fund. Doors open at 16:00.

4. Member spotlight
This month we meet Aiko from Paperbridge, a two-person studio that makes tactile maps. She has worked from desk 9 since March and gives her tip on surviving a Danish winter: wool socks and a thermos.

5. Quiet hours reminder
The third floor remains a quiet zone until 14:00 on weekdays. Phone calls belong in the booths.

6. Coming up
Founders' breakfast, 8 October. Open lab on paper prototyping, 21 October. Halloween potluck, 30 October.

That's all for now. See you in the kitchen.

The Lykkegade team

You can unsubscribe at any time using the link at the bottom of our website. Lykkegade Cowork, Havnegade 12, 1058 Copenhagen K.
mails.justification: A monthly newsletter the recipient subscribed to, which reads like marketing with a discount code, but it asks nothing and needs no reply.

mails.subject: Objet trouvé : un carnet bleu dans la cuisine ?
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je ne suis pas membre de votre espace, je suis venue mardi dernier pour un atelier d'écriture organisé par une autre association, dans la grande salle du premier étage. Je me permets de vous écrire parce que je ne retrouve plus mon carnet depuis ce soir-là.

C'est un carnet à couverture rigide bleu nuit, format A5, avec un élastique gris et une étiquette à mon nom collée à l'intérieur. Il contient des notes de travail pour un projet de livre, donc il compte beaucoup pour moi. Je l'ai peut-être oublié sur une table ou dans la cuisine, car j'ai pris un thé avant de partir.

Pourriez-vous vérifier si quelqu'un l'a trouvé ? Si oui, je peux passer le récupérer jeudi ou vendredi, ou bien vous pouvez me l'envoyer par la poste et je rembourserai les frais d'envoi.

Je comprends bien que vous recevez beaucoup de messages et que ce n'est pas votre priorité. Si vous avez une boîte d'objets trouvés, un coup d'oeil rapide me rassurerait.

Je peux aussi vous décrire plus précisément le contenu pour prouver que le carnet est le mien. Il y a notamment un plan de roman sur les dix premières pages.

Je vous remercie d'avance pour votre aide et vous souhaite une bonne semaine.

Cordialement,
Camille Roussel
mails.justification: A visitor who is not a member asks about a lost notebook after attending an event in the space; the unfamiliar sender is a genuine person with a question, answerable within the week.

mails.subject: Fwd: Trial day and desk prices
mails.body:
Can you answer this one? I think they'd be a good fit for the quiet floor.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Ravi Menon <ravi@menon-lab.example>
Date: 16 Sep 2026

Hi,

I'm a freelance UX researcher, currently working from home in Valby and it's getting lonely. I would like to join for at least six months. Could I do a trial day next week, and what does a fixed desk cost per month? Are there any free desks on the quiet floor?

Separately: I run a monthly meetup on research methods, about 25 people, and we're looking for a new venue starting in October. We could host it at your place on a Thursday evening in the first week of next month, if that's of interest. Happy to pay for the room.

Best,
Ravi
mails.justification: A prospective member asks about a trial day and desk prices, forwarded by a colleague; the meetup offer is secondary and the sender expects a personal reply within the week.
